1) yarn tsc: plugins/scaffolder-react/src/next/hooks/useTemplateSchema.ts:130:13 - error TS2322: Type 'unknown[]' is not assignable to type 'JsonValue | undefined'. (the allOf/oneOf/anyOf map assigns unknown[] to filtered[keyword]; type the items as JsonValue / JsonObject).

Cause: filterSchemaByFeatureFlags filters `required` down to keys present in the same node's `properties`, which wrongly drops required keys whose property is declared elsewhere (in the parent schema or another branch). Only remove a required key when that key itself was removed by a feature-flag filter; never change a schema that has no feature-flagged properties.
